title: Training Note: Dual-Fuel Bundle Reduction on Residential Electricity Supply Renewal Rates
content:
Training note on the dual-fuel bundle reduction applied to Residential Electricity Supply renewal rates.

**Q. What is the bundle reduction?**
A. A reduction of the renewal rate in cents per kWh, tiered on the dual-fuel credit lines the agreement carries for recent billing cycles. The dual-fuel credit lines on the agreement whose billing cycle started less than twelve whole months before the election date are counted; with 11 or more such lines the full bundle reduction of 0.30 cents per kWh applies, with 6 to 10 such lines the partial bundle reduction of 0.15 cents per kWh applies, and with fewer than 6 no bundle reduction applies.

**Q. Which lines count?**
A. Dual-fuel credit lines on the electricity agreement's bills, each identified by its billing period start. A line counts when fewer than 12 whole months separate its billing period start from the election date; a line whose cycle started 12 or more whole months earlier does not count.

**Q. Where do the boundaries fall?**
A. 11 lines take 0.30 cents and 10 lines take 0.15 cents; 6 lines take 0.15 cents and 5 lines take none.

| Dual-fuel credit lines counted | Bundle reduction (cents per kWh) |
|---|---|
| 11 or more | 0.30 |
| 6 to 10 | 0.15 |
| fewer than 6 | none |

**Q. A hypothetical count?**
A. Election on 2026-06-20; dual-fuel credit lines for cycles starting 2025-06-21 through 2026-05-21, one per month, are 12 lines inside the window: 0.30 cents per kWh.
